params.body:
Curate's front page: how many posts stand under the lead, and posts kept at a place while new ones arrive. Plus covers in the list of posts.

## Front page

- The number of posts under the lead is an underlined choice in the Posts line ("The newest leads, then 5 under it"), 0 to 24 within `frontRange`. It is stored: a new post takes the first free place and the oldest drops off.
- Drop a post on a place, or press Keep here, and it stays there (`POST /site/front/place`, pipeline PR). The other places fill newest first around it, the way the site fills them (`arrangeUnder`, after the site's `Article::frontPage`). A kept card says Kept here, let go.
- Reset order lets kept places go as well as the pinned lead. Every change has Undo, including putting back the post a keep displaced.
- Curate now loads all live posts (up to 200), not the newest fifty: a kept post can be older than that.
- The drop reads the post's id from the drag itself; the dragging state is set a tick after the drag starts.

## Posts

- Each row shows its cover, or "No cover". gentells.com fills a missing cover with a piece of the collage chosen from the title, which hid that 23 live posts have none.
- The live list is all posts, newest publication first, as on gentells.com. It was a page of twenty by last change, which put a September post between two from October.

## Checks

- `npm test` 47/47 (three new cases for `arrangeUnder`), `vite build` clean.
- In a local Studio against a copy of production and the pipeline PR: the count changed to 5 and showed five posts; dragging the fourth post to place 1 moved it there and the others slid down by date; Keep here held a post at place 3; Reset order put the date order back; the posts list showed all 78 newest first, 23 of them "No cover".

Merge after the pipeline and site PRs.
params.title: Curate: the number of posts under the lead, kept places, covers in the posts list
